name: NORTHWESTERN PACIFIC RAILROAD CO. v. PUBLIC UTILITIES COMMISSION OF CALIFORNIA
name_abbreviation: Northwestern Pacific Railroad v. Public Utilities Commission

court.name: Supreme Court of the United States

parties: NORTHWESTERN PACIFIC RAILROAD CO. v. PUBLIC UTILITIES COMMISSION OF CALIFORNIA.

opinions.text:
Per Curiam.
The motion of the City of San Rafael, California, et al. for leave to be named parties appellee is denied. The motion to dismiss is granted and the appeal is dismissed for want of a substantial federal question.
opinions.author: Per Curiam.

attorneys: Thormund A. Miller, Jeremiah C. Waterman and Randolph Karr for appellant.
Mary Moran Pajalich and Hector Anninos for appellee.
Boris H. Lakusta for the City of San Rafael et al.
